items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: They did the Joni Mitchell stuff.

ctx.x: Tom Scott would? © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
Tom Scott did an album there, it was the LA Express of course. They did the Joni Mitchell stuff. But then he went to New York and did one called the New York Connection with all those guys.
